newsitem.title: FRANCE: French finances under control - Arthuis.
newsitem.headline: French finances under control - Arthuis.

text.p: Finance Minister Jean Arthuis said on Monday that public finances were under control and there would be no need to raise social security charges.
"Public finances are under control," Arthuis told a news conference.
Speaking on social security charges, he said: "There is no reason to change."
Arthuis reiterated that there was no truth to some media reports that France would overshoot its three percent deficit target for 1997.
